title: The work is self-distributed, not peer reviewed, with language models credited as co-authors

statements.text: The program is deposited by its authors on Zenodo, Academia.edu and Substack, and none of it has passed peer review. Many of its papers credit language models as co-authors or verifiers, such as Claude on the helical solar system paper and Copilot on Kolesnikov's papers, and posts paste a model's replies directly.
